ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase no minimum amount of Services in each of the next three years on a usage basis, and pays only for Services ordered or used.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination right, and it contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment. The edit removes the minimum amount and confirms we pay only for Services ordered or used.
input.summary: Remove the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment; payment only for Services ordered or used.
